name: pane-body-composer-gap
description: A pane that docks a footer (the session pane's composer) closes its scrolling body on that footer's own top hairline, with no dead band below the last content row, while a footer-less pane keeps the body's end-of-scroll inset.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: remove the rule that zeroes the bottom padding of a body whose pane docks a footer
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-11: without the rule this case fails at 1440px with a 24.0px empty band above the docked footer (body padding-bottom 24px), and the live hub showed the same 24px between the transcript's scroll port and the composer's hairline at 1500x1000. The footer-less control still read 24px in both runs.
